command_line:
set -eu
INPUT_PATH="/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79162898/inputs/dataset_1539f682-6ad4-42c8-bc0a-33a951ca978c.dat"
export INPUT_PATH
{
  echo "Rscript version:"
  Rscript --vanilla --version
  echo "Running script"
  Rscript --vanilla -e 'suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2)); res <- readRDS(Sys.getenv("INPUT_PATH")); df <- as.data.frame(res); cat("nrow", nrow(df), "\n"); cat("columns", paste(colnames(df), collapse=","), "\n"); cat("both", sum(!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$padj < 0.05 & abs(df$log2FoldChange) > 1.5), "\n")'
} > diag.txt 2>&1 || true
